zh.name: 人参
zh.functions: 传统中医药文化中常用于补气、扶正和体力调养。
zh.usage: 常见于煲汤、泡茶及传统方剂的文化介绍。
zh.precautions: 不应作为自行治疗依据；孕期、慢性病患者或正在服药者应先咨询专业人士。
zh.description: 五加科植物人参的干燥根，是常见的补气类药材。

en.name: Ginseng
en.functions: Traditionally discussed for supporting qi, vitality and general resilience.
en.usage: Commonly presented in soups, teas and traditional formula education.
en.precautions: Do not use as a basis for self-treatment; seek professional advice if pregnant, chronically ill or taking medicine.
en.description: The dried root of Panax ginseng, a well-known herb in TCM culture.

ms.name: Ginseng
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dibincangkan untuk menyokong qi, tenaga dan daya tahan badan.
ms.usage: Lazim diperkenalkan dalam sup, teh dan pembelajaran formula tradisional.
ms.precautions: Jangan jadikan asas rawatan sendiri; dapatkan nasihat profesional jika hamil, berpenyakit kronik atau mengambil ubat.
ms.description: Akar kering Panax ginseng, herba yang terkenal dalam budaya TCM.

zh.name: 枸杞子
zh.functions: 传统上与养肝明目及日常调养相关。
zh.usage: 常用于泡茶、煮粥或煲汤。
zh.precautions: 正在服药、血糖异常或体质特殊者应先咨询专业人士。
zh.description: 茄科植物宁夏枸杞的成熟果实，常见于药食文化。

en.name: Goji Berry
en.functions: Traditionally associated with liver and eye nourishment and everyday wellness.
en.usage: Often used in tea, porridge or soup.
en.precautions: People taking medicine or managing blood sugar should seek professional advice.
en.description: The mature fruit of Lycium barbarum, widely used in food and TCM culture.

ms.name: Buah Goji
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dikaitkan dengan penjagaan hati, mata dan kesihatan harian.
ms.usage: Sering digunakan dalam teh, bubur atau sup.
ms.precautions: Individu yang mengambil ubat atau mengawal gula darah perlu mendapatkan nasihat profesional.
ms.description: Buah matang Lycium barbarum yang biasa dalam budaya makanan dan TCM.

zh.name: 黄芪
zh.functions: 传统上用于补气固表相关的中医药知识。
zh.usage: 常见于煲汤和传统方剂介绍。
zh.precautions: 不建议自行长期或大量使用；免疫相关疾病患者应先咨询专业人士。
zh.description: 豆科植物蒙古黄芪或膜荚黄芪的干燥根。

en.name: Astragalus
en.functions: Traditionally discussed in relation to supporting qi and the body's exterior defense.
en.usage: Often presented in soups and traditional formula education.
en.precautions: Avoid prolonged or excessive self-use; consult a professional for immune-related conditions.
en.description: The dried root of Astragalus membranaceus and related medicinal species.

ms.name: Astragalus
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dibincangkan untuk menyokong qi dan pertahanan luaran badan.
ms.usage: Sering diperkenalkan dalam sup dan formula tradisional.
ms.precautions: Elakkan penggunaan sendiri secara lama atau berlebihan; rujuk profesional bagi keadaan berkaitan imun.
ms.description: Akar kering Astragalus membranaceus dan spesies perubatan berkaitan.

zh.name: 当归
zh.functions: 传统中医药文化中常与补血、活血知识相关。
zh.usage: 常见于煲汤和传统方剂介绍。
zh.precautions: 孕期、有出血倾向或使用抗凝药者应咨询专业人士。
zh.description: 伞形科植物当归的干燥根。

en.name: Chinese Angelica
en.functions: Traditionally associated with nourishing and moving blood in TCM theory.
en.usage: Often discussed in soups and traditional formulas.
en.precautions: Seek professional advice during pregnancy, with bleeding disorders or when using anticoagulants.
en.description: The dried root of Angelica sinensis.

ms.name: Angelika Cina
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dikaitkan dengan menyubur dan menggerakkan darah dalam teori TCM.
ms.usage: Sering dibincangkan dalam sup dan formula tradisional.
ms.precautions: Dapatkan nasihat profesional ketika hamil, mengalami gangguan pendarahan atau menggunakan antikoagulan.

zh.name: 甘草
zh.functions: 传统方剂中常用于调和诸药，也见于咽喉相关知识介绍。
zh.usage: 多作为传统方剂组成部分介绍。
zh.precautions: 长期或大量使用可能带来血压及电解质风险。
zh.description: 豆科甘草属植物的干燥根和根茎。

en.name: Licorice Root
en.functions: Traditionally used to harmonize formula ingredients and discussed in throat-related contexts.
en.usage: Usually presented as one component of traditional formulas.
en.precautions: Long-term or high intake can affect blood pressure and electrolytes.
en.description: The dried root and rhizome of medicinal Glycyrrhiza species.

ms.name: Akar Likuoris
ms.functions: Secara tradisi digunakan untuk mengimbangi ramuan formula dan dalam topik berkaitan tekak.
ms.usage: Biasanya diperkenalkan sebagai salah satu komponen formula tradisional.
ms.precautions: Pengambilan lama atau tinggi boleh menjejaskan tekanan darah dan elektrolit.
ms.description: Akar dan rizom kering spesies Glycyrrhiza perubatan.

zh.name: 生姜
zh.functions: 传统上与散寒、温中及和胃知识相关。
zh.usage: 常用于饮食、姜茶及传统方剂介绍。
zh.precautions: 胃部敏感、出血风险或正在服药者不宜大量自行使用。
zh.description: 姜科植物姜的新鲜根茎，也是常见食材。

en.name: Fresh Ginger
en.functions: Traditionally associated with dispersing cold, warming the middle and settling the stomach.
en.usage: Used in food, ginger tea and traditional formula education.
en.precautions: Avoid excessive self-use with gastric sensitivity, bleeding risk or interacting medicines.
en.description: The fresh rhizome of Zingiber officinale and a familiar culinary ingredient.

ms.name: Halia Segar
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dikaitkan dengan mengusir sejuk, memanaskan bahagian tengah dan menenangkan perut.
ms.usage: Digunakan dalam makanan, teh halia dan pembelajaran formula tradisional.
ms.precautions: Elakkan penggunaan berlebihan jika perut sensitif, berisiko pendarahan atau mengambil ubat berkaitan.
ms.description: Rizom segar Zingiber officinale dan bahan masakan yang lazim.

zh.name: 大枣
zh.functions: 传统上与补中益气、养血及调和药性相关。
zh.usage: 常用于煲汤、煮粥或传统方剂。
zh.precautions: 含糖量较高，血糖管理人群应注意用量。
zh.description: 鼠李科植物枣的成熟果实，兼具食用文化。

en.name: Chinese Jujube
en.functions: Traditionally associated with supporting the middle, nourishing blood and harmonizing formulas.
en.usage: Often used in soup, porridge or traditional formulas.
en.precautions: Naturally high in sugar; portions matter for people managing blood glucose.
en.description: The mature fruit of Ziziphus jujuba, also widely eaten as food.

ms.name: Kurma Merah Cina
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dikaitkan dengan menyokong bahagian tengah, menyuburkan darah dan mengimbangi formula.
ms.usage: Sering digunakan dalam sup, bubur atau formula tradisional.
ms.precautions: Kandungan gula semula jadi tinggi; kawal bahagian jika mengurus glukosa darah.
ms.description: Buah matang Ziziphus jujuba yang turut dimakan sebagai makanan.

zh.name: 菊花
zh.functions: 传统上与疏散风热、清肝明目相关。
zh.usage: 常见于代茶饮和传统配伍介绍。
zh.precautions: 对菊科植物过敏或体质特殊者应谨慎。
zh.description: 菊科植物菊的干燥头状花序。

en.name: Chrysanthemum Flower
en.functions: Traditionally associated with dispersing wind-heat and supporting eye comfort.
en.usage: Commonly infused as tea or presented in traditional combinations.
en.precautions: Use caution with allergies to plants in the daisy family.
en.description: The dried flower head of Chrysanthemum morifolium.

ms.name: Bunga Kekwa
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dikaitkan dengan menyuraikan angin-haba dan menyokong keselesaan mata.
ms.usage: Lazim direndam sebagai teh atau diperkenalkan dalam gabungan tradisional.
ms.precautions: Berhati-hati jika alah kepada tumbuhan keluarga daisi.

zh.name: 薄荷
zh.functions: 传统上与疏散风热、清利头目及利咽相关。
zh.usage: 少量用于茶饮或传统方剂介绍。
zh.precautions: 精油浓度较高，不应随意内服；幼儿使用需格外谨慎。
zh.description: 唇形科植物薄荷的干燥地上部分。

en.name: Chinese Mint
en.functions: Traditionally associated with dispersing wind-heat and soothing the head and throat.
en.usage: Used sparingly in infusions and traditional formulas.
en.precautions: Concentrated essential oil should not be swallowed casually; extra caution is needed for children.
en.description: The dried aerial parts of Mentha haplocalyx.

ms.name: Pudina Cina
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dikaitkan dengan menyuraikan angin-haba serta melegakan kepala dan tekak.
ms.usage: Digunakan sedikit dalam rendaman dan formula tradisional.
ms.precautions: Minyak pati pekat tidak patut ditelan sewenang-wenangnya; lebih berhati-hati untuk kanak-kanak.
ms.description: Bahagian atas tanah Mentha haplocalyx yang dikeringkan.

zh.name: 莲子
zh.functions: 传统上与补脾、养心及固涩知识相关。
zh.usage: 常用于甜汤、粥品和传统配伍。
zh.precautions: 消化不适或便秘时应注意用量。
zh.description: 睡莲科植物莲的成熟种子。

en.name: Lotus Seed
en.functions: Traditionally associated with supporting the spleen, nourishing the heart and stabilizing.
en.usage: Commonly used in desserts, porridge and traditional combinations.
en.precautions: Portion control may help if digestion is sluggish or constipation occurs.
en.description: The mature seed of Nelumbo nucifera.

ms.name: Biji Teratai
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dikaitkan dengan menyokong limpa, menyuburkan jantung dan menstabilkan.
ms.usage: Lazim digunakan dalam pencuci mulut, bubur dan gabungan tradisional.
ms.precautions: Kawal jumlah jika penghadaman perlahan atau mengalami sembelit.

zh.name: 肉桂
zh.functions: 传统上与温里散寒、助阳相关。
zh.usage: 少量见于烹饪、饮品及传统方剂介绍。
zh.precautions: 孕期、肝病患者或使用抗凝药者不宜自行大量使用。
zh.description: 樟科植物肉桂的干燥树皮。

en.name: Chinese Cinnamon
en.functions: Traditionally associated with warming the interior, dispersing cold and supporting yang.
en.usage: Used in small amounts in cooking, drinks and traditional formulas.
en.precautions: Avoid high self-directed intake during pregnancy, with liver disease or anticoagulant use.
en.description: The dried bark of Cinnamomum cassia.

ms.name: Kayu Manis Cina
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dikaitkan dengan memanaskan dalaman, mengusir sejuk dan menyokong yang.
ms.usage: Digunakan sedikit dalam masakan, minuman dan formula tradisional.
ms.precautions: Elakkan pengambilan sendiri yang tinggi ketika hamil, berpenyakit hati atau menggunakan antikoagulan.

zh.name: 陈皮
zh.functions: 传统上与理气健脾、燥湿化痰知识相关。
zh.usage: 常用于煲汤、茶饮及传统方剂。
zh.precautions: 口干或体质偏燥者应注意用量，并避免以食疗替代治疗。
zh.description: 芸香科植物橘及其栽培变种的干燥成熟果皮。

en.name: Aged Tangerine Peel
en.functions: Traditionally associated with regulating qi, supporting digestion and transforming dampness.
en.usage: Often used in soups, infusions and traditional formulas.
en.precautions: Use moderately if prone to dryness, and do not replace needed treatment with food therapy.
en.description: The dried mature peel of Citrus reticulata varieties.

ms.name: Kulit Limau Kering
ms.functions: Secara tradisi dikaitkan dengan mengawal qi, menyokong penghadaman dan menangani kelembapan.
ms.usage: Sering digunakan dalam sup, rendaman dan formula tradisional.
ms.precautions: Gunakan sederhana jika mudah kering dan jangan gantikan rawatan yang diperlukan dengan terapi makanan.
ms.description: Kulit buah matang Citrus reticulata yang dikeringkan.
